title: FeralUI v0.1.1: physically inspired React components that swing and crumple
summary: FeralUI v0.1.1 is an experimental component library whose drop-in parts swing, grab, crumple, and catch light. Homepage catalog includes PullCord, Claw, Crumple, Hologram, Blinds, and Blob for tactile marketing heroes.
question_it_answers: Which component library ships physically inspired motion primitives instead of standard fade-and-slide kits?

claims.text: Components are marketed as swinging, grabbing, crumpling, and catching light rather than standard UI motion.
claims.evidence: Real components you can drop in, that happen to swing, grab, crumple, and catch the light.
claims.subject: web-3d-scenes

claims.text: Homepage lists PullCord, Claw, Crumple, Hologram, Blinds, Blob, and other experimental modules.
claims.evidence: PullCord, Claw, Captcha, Gradient Builder, MotionView, Screenery, DeskFolio, Blinds, Blob, AniMaps, Fur, Vacuum, Crumple, Hologram, Matchday
claims.subject: web-3d-scenes
